company.name: Property Finder
company.shortDescription: Property Finder is a real estate listing platform that allows users to search for rental and sale properties.
company.description:
Property Finder is a digital real estate platform in the Middle East and North Africa region, connecting property seekers with verified listings across various markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Qatar, Bahrain, and Turkey. It delivers an online real estate marketplace where users can browse, buy, rent, or invest in residential and commercial properties via its web and mobile applications.
The company offers specialized tools for professionals, including myCRM Pro for managing leads and client interactions with API integrations, Data Finder for real-time analytics and market insights, Lead Tracker for monitoring customer engagement and pricing, Mortgage Finder for tailored mortgage guidance, and Online Masterclass for digital education in real estate.
